headline: Approved FY27 budget allocation of $45k between grants and commission projects
summary: The commission approved the August 2026 minutes and approved an allocation percentage for grants versus commission projects for the $45k budget for the fiscal year. Members also discussed reappointments to the commission and formed a grants subcommittee for FY27.
decisions: Approved the current budget allocation for FY27 grants versus commission projects.

plain_text:
Nashua Arts Commission 
Meeting minutes 
Sept. 8, 2026 
In attendance: 
Jennifer Annand 
Tina Cassidy 
Sara Ceaser 
Paula Lochhead 
Stephanie Moll 
Lindsay Rinaldi 
Lauren Spira-Savett
Absent: Chuck Emmons, Faith Mandravelis, Jane Marquis 
City reps: Alderman-at-Large Morgan, Kathleen Palmer 
 
Call to Order: 8:06 am. Roll Call of Members. 
Motion to Approve: August 2026 minutes – Motion to Approve was made by Paula and seconded by 
Stephanie, all in favor. Motion carried. 
Chairman’s Report 
Discussion on reappointments and waitlist for commission. Mike McDowell needs to be sworn in, but there are 
still two openings, with four people interested. Lindsay and Jenn will arrange conversations with interested 
parties, in order to make recommendations to Mayor. 
Old Business 
FY27 Budget and Project Planning: Lindsay proposed an allocation percentage for grants versus 
commission projects of the $45k the commission has for this fiscal year. After some talk about formerly 
discussed proposed projects, some potential financial partnerships to accomplish them, and a call to 
action for the commission members to review them before the next meeting (eg, review Mindmap and 
those mentioned in previous meeting Minutes), a Motion to Approve the current budget allocation was 
made by Lauren, seconded by Tina, all in favor. Motion carried. 
New Business 
Grant subcommittee: The FY27 grants subcommittee was roughly formed, with Jenn as current Chair 
(first meeting will include electing a new Chair, so Jenn can train that person in advance of her upcoming term 
ending) and Lauren and Sara volunteering to be members. Jenn will reach out to others to see if they will 
participate. 
 
 
 
MORE, Pg. 2
ACTION ITEMS for all commissioners: 
GOAL: Identify a list of priorities (both strategic and project-based) for the NAC to achieve in the 
current fiscal year. 
All commissioners are asked to review past project proposals and be prepared to advocate for the projects you 
want to see as part of this year's workload. New project ideas are also welcome. Please run your preferred 
projects through the NAC Project Rubric so that you come to the meeting with a score.  
 
Motion to Adjourn: 9:18 am, made by Paula, seconded by Tina, all in favor. Motion carried. 
Next Meeting:  8 am Tuesday, October 13, 2026 
 
 
 
Attachments 
 
FYI- some of these files are big and will take some time to load. Please have patience. 
• Digital Kiosk pricing quotes from June 26 minutes 
• Project Proposals from April 26 minutes  
• Arts Projects Brainstorm Map submitted by Liz and NAC Project Rubric from Jan 26 minutes
